name: Orange Essence Oil
description: Orange Essence Oil (CAS 68606-94-0 ), also known as terpeneless sweet orange oil, is a concentrated citrus extract produced by removing terpene fractions from cold-pressed orange peel oil. With FEMA number 2822 , it delivers a more stable, water-soluble orange flavor and aroma profile than standard orange oil, making it the preferred choice for applications where emulsification and shelf stability are critical. In food and beverage manufacturing, it functions as a flavoring agent in carbonated drinks, confectionery, dairy products, and baked goods where terpene-free solubility is required for clear emulsions. Personal care formulators incorporate it into fragrances, lip balms, and skin care products as both a scent component and carrier material. The printing and packaging industry uses it as a bio-based solvent. In ink formulations, its citrus-derived composition supports compliance with low-VOC and sustainability requirements. Beverage producers also rely on it to flavor alcoholic spirits and liqueurs without cloudiness. Orange Essence Oil is supplied as a liquid, typically in drums or smaller packaging suited to flavor and fragrance workflows. Food-grade material conforming to FCC specifications is standard. Natural-grade designations are available for clean-label formulations. Technical-grade supply is also available for solvent and industrial end uses, ensuring versatility across multiple manufacturing sectors. Contact us for supply of Orange Essence Oil Request Quote
